nodes.label: LLM Backend Priority: llama.cpp > Ollama > Null
nodes.rationale: llama.cpp chosen as primary because it runs in-process without an external server, has direct CUDA/Metal access with no HTTP overhead, and gives full control over context and memory — critical for fitting both Whisper and an LLM into 8GB VRAM.
nodes.norm_label: llm backend priority: llama.cpp > ollama > null

nodes.label: VRAM Unload Strategy: LLM before Whisper
nodes.rationale: RTX 5060 has only 8GB VRAM, insufficient to run both the LLM (5GB) and Whisper large-v2 (4GB+) simultaneously, so the LLM is explicitly unloaded before Whisper loads.
nodes.norm_label: vram unload strategy: llm before whisper

nodes.label: Adaptive Denoise Strength Based on SNR Quality
nodes.rationale: Denoise aggressiveness scales with audio quality (EXCELENTE=0.5, DIFÍCIL=0.9) to avoid over-processing good audio while maximally cleaning difficult audio.
nodes.norm_label: adaptive denoise strength based on snr quality

nodes.label: CUDA OOM Fallback to CPU int8
nodes.rationale: Blackwell GPU may run out of VRAM for large Whisper models; the pipeline catches CUDA OOM exceptions and retries transparently on CPU to avoid crashing the user's job.
nodes.norm_label: cuda oom fallback to cpu int8
